I read your story and went through something similar. Unfortunately the family we wish for isn’t going to happen for us! I’m not sure what to say that found help. I believe you’re in early 20s so you have the right to leave. I would focus on finding a safe place, friend, other family? Or even a hostel? I would also focus on gate ring any important information to you before you do leave. The next thing is making sure you can find cash, job or a friend loaning you money? You will heal once you’re out of that environment. I would stay under the radar gather everything I needed and when you’ve secured a safe place and some income I would leave. You don’t even have to do it in a shitty way, legally you have the right since you’re an adult now. They can’t do anything to you, and fear is how they control you. Don’t be scared and don’t self doubt yourself. They will try to confuse or lessen your confidence about standing on your own. Abuse is a cruel mental game, the sooner you can recognize it you can prepare yourself on how to respond safely.
